waves.name: Nightly chain (wrapper, JOBA, JOBB)
waves.rationale: The whole live system is one wrapper that submits two jobs in a fixed order. There is no call, data or contract coupling to cut along, and the only coupling is the JOBA-before-JOBB order, so splitting the two jobs would break the one constraint the tree enforces. One wave.
waves.unblocks: The order and return-code harness for the nightly cycle, and the decision to delete JOBC. Nothing else in this tree depends on it.

unassigned.reason: Retired per the wrapper comment and not submitted. It is a deletion candidate, not a port unit. Confirm with the client first.
